caption: The video depicts a clear cylindrical glass resting on a white surface against a teal wall, holding two stacked liquid layers: a transparent lower layer and a yellow-olive band above it. A yellow straw stands inside with its lower tip fixed at the bottom center and its upper portion extending above the rim out of frame. Refraction through the curved glass and the oil layer displaces the submerged portion laterally, so the straw appears broken into offset segments at the air-oil and oil-water boundaries rather than one straight line. Throughout the excerpt the straw rotates steadily about its anchored base, its top end drifting from a near-vertical orientation into a pronounced leftward lean. As it tilts, the refracted segments shift with it and the apparent kinks move leftward while the lower tip stays in place. The glass, the liquid layers and the background hold fixed positions, indicating a static camera. No hand or other object is visible to explain the tilt.
relations: The yellow straw, anchored at the glass's bottom center, steadily tilts leftward from its near-vertical initial state.
Refraction at the liquid boundaries makes the submerged straw appear broken into laterally displaced segments.
As the straw tilts, the apparent kinks at the interfaces shift leftward while the anchored base remains fixed.
The glass, liquid layers, and background remain stationary throughout the straw's continuous rotational movement.
